title: Arkret Durable Device Revocation State
description: Durable exact-device revocation fence. A receiver that knows this authenticated pending/revoked state blocks affected new live actions locally. Unknown remote revocation can have a propagation window for ordinary data. Fresh proof issue is not a separate Event admission action. Terminal safety outcomes preserve exact transaction, authorization and generation binding.

device_revocation_gate_record.description: Gate-relevant durable state for an exact device generation. Rejected records are audit history and are excluded; pending and revoked records remain visible together so committing one transaction cannot hide another surviving pending transaction.

device_generation_ref.description: Reducer-derived PCR-local monotonic current device-generation selector. A producer MUST NOT self-report it and it MUST NOT equal or be derived from a DID versionId.

denied_actions.description: Closed canonical action-class list blocked by revocation_pending on every deployment.

target_device_authorize_event_id.description: Reducer-derived accepted ak.device.authorize Event targeted by this proposal.

proposal_event_id.description: The complete accepted revoke Event identifier and the sole wire source of that Event digest. Consumers recover the digest from this identifier when validating a terminal decision; this record MUST NOT duplicate it as a sibling field.

accepted_at.description: Actual durable atomic-commit time assigned when the Event, derived selectors and pending index commit. It is assigned by the authority transaction and MUST NOT be producer supplied.

acceptance_seq.description: Monotonic sequence assigned by the origin Station in the same atomic commit as accepted_at and the pending index.
